_comment: BCM 0x620 lamp output DIDs for UDS 0x2F InputOutputControl (force 2F <did> 03 01, release 2F <did> 00). Bench-mapped empirically on the truck 2026-11-24 (engine running = stable session). The firmware's DID->lamp mapping is icall-dispatched and was NOT statically resolvable, so these are live-observed. confirmed=clearly seen; tentative=seen but attribution fuzzy.
notes: state byte valid range is small (0x01/0x02 accepted; 0x04+ -> requestOutOfRange). Actuation works with ENGINE RUNNING (session stable); engine-off made the BCM drop the diagnostic session. Responses are intermittently dropped on the busy bus - retry the force until POSITIVE.
